quote: 'The Quarry is raw quartzite'; 'Rocket Reef is the lowest section of the continuous, winding limestone ridge.'
note: Wall pages: Reef 'Sharp and solid limestone'; Rocket Reef 'This north-facing limestone wall'; Upper Reef 'More of the Grandeur Peak quality limestone'; Quarry 'dirty, broken quartzite is local fare at the Quarry' (crag page agrees). Aspects: Reef 'The northern aspect of the wall'; Rocket Reef 'north-facing'. Upper Reef page says 'Southwest facing' but crag page says 'All areas are north facing' - conflict, left out. Quarry 'Enter the box canyon with the north-facing wall' not plainly the wall's own aspect - left out.

quote: 'The rock is Limestone and tends to be sharp so extra finger tips are advised.'
note: Crag on one rock; Castlevania page also 'castle-like limestone structure'. Aspects: Buffalo Bill Wall 'This crag faces due East'; Gammelstock 'Being west facing'. Eye of the Needle Wall description is only the terse 'North Facing.' - left out. Tower Ridge none.

quote: 'The rock here is Little Cottonwood's famous quartz monzonite'
note: Purple Wall page also 'overhanging quartz monzonite'. Aspects: Purple Wall 'The wall is east-facing'; The Puzzle 'a west-facing slab'. Crag-wide 'Most of the cliffs are east-facing' is hedged, not carried down.

quote: Shard Boulder description: 'The quartzite boulder in between the Golden Egg and The Gemstone'
note: Crag page names no rock. Dice Cube 'different kind of rock than the granite in LCC' (unnamed). Gemstone, Pocket, Golden Egg, Dynomite pages name no rock (Gemstone only a photo caption 'large quartzite boulder' - not used). Shard exception rests on its one-sentence description.

quote: Parent: 'The rock is a mix of greenstone and granite'
note: Parent-only and mixed. Barred Owl Area and its 4 boulder pages name no rock or aspect.

quote: 'Composed of really solid light grey stone.'

quote: Crag and 5 boulder pages name no rock

note: MP area is now titled 'Right Blasters' (same 5 boulders, under Keelowkee Lake > Blaster Blocks; its page says 'Starting with Horrindo and moving to the right is all Front Blaster territory'). Lost World only 'fine grit sand stone texture' (texture wording) and Missionary names no rock - left in the unclear group.

note: Crag page names no rock; only Burden Boulder (texture wording) of 10 walls mentions sandstone; others name none ('iron texture', 'good stone'). No aspects (Mighty Boulder only morning light).

quote: 'The rock quality is fantastic!' (no rock named)

quote: Crag, Burnt Mountain and 5 boulder pages name no rock

note: Crag page names no rock; Indian Brook, Tree Farm, Roadside on Rt 15 pages name none. Red Rocks Boulder page says limestone but UVM bedrock page says Red Rocks Park shows Monkton Quartzite (park-wide) - sources disagree, so no exception.

quote: 'Rock quality is quite amazing and the landings tend to be flat.' (no rock named)
